arStrings.szText: "How do you know so much about demons?"
I have not been...entirely truthful with you. I was not always a dealer in antiquities. Years ago, I was a Vizjerei mage.
There was a tragedy, a demon incursion that wiped out an entire village. The slaughter was...horrific.

I was accused of being responsible, of summoning the demons. I swear to you, I would never do such a thing. But blame needed to be heaped upon someone. And I was the easiest target. I fled, and was Vizjerei no more.
I must ask you to keep all this in confidence, wanderer. We must let nothing stand in the way of stopping Belial.
